description: Prepare cashing a running loan out: its whole collateral is sold through an aggregator, the loan repaid from the sale, and the rest less gage's 0.5% fee paid to the wallet, in one transaction. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

engine.description: The engine; the current core when omitted, the loan's own core for a loan in a lend asset

maxSlippageBps.description: Most the net you receive may fall below the quote, in bps of it; 50 when omitted

minNet.description: The least you accept to receive, raw units of the loan's asset (USDG: 6 decimals): the cash-out is refused under it, and its transaction reverts under it

name: gage_prepare_cash_out
title: Prepare: Cash a loan out
